sources.title: SpaceX Form 10-Q for the quarter ended June 30, 2026

event.title: SpaceX completes its acquisition of xAI
event.summary: SpaceX completed its acquisition of X.AI Holdings, the parent of xAI and X, through a share exchange. xAI became a wholly owned subsidiary of SpaceX, which now reports an AI segment.

facts.label: Completion
facts.text: Completed on February 2, 2026; xAI became a wholly owned subsidiary of SpaceX.
facts.quote: On February 2, 2026 ("xAI Merger Date"), the Company completed its acquisition of X.AI Holdings Corp. ("xAI"), pursuant to which xAI became a wholly-owned subsidiary of the Company ("xAI Merger").

facts.label: Structure
facts.text: Both this merger and xAI's earlier merger with X were share exchanges.
facts.quote: The Mergers were each effected through a share exchange.

facts.label: Earlier merger
facts.text: xAI had acquired X Holdings Corp. on March 28, 2025.
facts.quote: Prior to the xAI Merger, on March 28, 2025, xAI completed its acquisition of X Holdings Corp. ("X") and X.AI Corp., in which X and X.AI Corp. became wholly-owned subsidiaries of xAI

facts.label: Segments
facts.text: SpaceX reports three segments: Space, Connectivity and AI.
facts.quote: three operating and reportable segments: (i) Space, (ii) Connectivity, and (iii) AI.
